newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar closes flat in busy trade.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar closes flat in busy trade.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed unchanged at 476.00/477.00 per dollar Monday, in quiet trading as the Central bank sold dollars to meet foreign currency demand, traders said.
"The market opened with quite a bit of currency demand but then it stabilized as the central bank came in and sold," a trader said.
Traders expect the exchange rate to remain little changed Tuesday as the Central Bank sought to control the bolivar's depreciation.
"I don't expect anything special for tomorrow. Demand will be sustained but the central bank will be watching out to cover demand and keep the exchange rate moving gradually," one said.
